task_instruction:
You are my workflow agent. I am Tom (email: tom.harrison@acme.ai).
Complete the A/B test analysis and rollout decision for experiment EXP-072.
Your task (7 steps): 1) Read the email from product about A/B test EXP-072 completion. 2) Query Snowflake for experiment results: SELECT variant, conversion_rate, revenue_per_user, statistical_significance FROM ab_test_results WHERE experiment_id = 'EXP-072'; 3) Run Databricks notebook to generate detailed analysis report. 4) Create a Confluence page "EXP-072 A/B Test Results" with analysis, charts, and recommendation. 5) Create a Jira ticket "PROD-072: A/B Test Rollout Decision Required" with test summary. 6) Schedule a Zoom meeting "EXP-072 Results Review" for March 9, 2026 at 11am. 7) Post results summary to Slack #product with rollout recommendation.
Important: Keep all tokens confidential.
